description: This file defines API router endpoints for managing a user's favorite recipes in a FastAPI application. It includes routes for listing, adding, and removing favorite recipes, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions.

methods.name: RecipeListOut list_favorites(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list the current authenticated user's favorite recipes, including their average ratings and rating counts.

methods.name: add_favorite(recipe_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a recipe to the current user's favorites, or return OK if already favorited.

methods.name: remove_favorite(recipe_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a recipe from the current user's favorites, or return OK if not found.

ctags.signature: (recipe_id: int, current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db))

ctags.pattern: /^def list_favorites(current_user: User = Depends(get_current_user), db: Session = Depends(get_db)/
